status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: Coin Metrics eth.csv is on disk (ADR 0099); its columns CapMVRVCur, FlowInExNtv, FlowOutExNtv, SplyExNtv, AdrActCnt, FeeTotNtv have never been read into a signal for timing. Only eth.csv and btc.csv carry exchange flows. btc.csv is not used (BTC is not read in S2). Rounds 1-7 (ADR 0096-0102) known, all NOT_PROMISING.
requested_by: 동동, 2026-11-20 '기준을 통과하는 전략이 나올때까지 계속 돌려 멈추지 말고'. Round 8 of that loop.

already_tested_not_repeated: aggregate funding and quarterly-basis timing (0098 AF1, 0100 QB1)
new_here: on-chain market timing of the alt index from Ethereum fundamentals: valuation (MVRV), exchange net flows, exchange-held supply, network activity

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.
position: when ON: long every U50 name equally (gross 1); when OFF: flat. Decided at cut (bar i-2) on the 14-day Monday grid, traded at the open of day i; weights drift; real funding; ADR 0041 calibrated cost

segments.BTCUSDT: not read in S2; btc.csv not read at all

trials.OC1_ETH_MVRV_TIMING: ON when ETH CapMVRVCur at cut <= its median over cut-179..cut (>= 120 values)
trials.OC2_ETH_NETFLOW_TIMING: net = FlowInExNtv - FlowOutExNtv; ON when the 7-day sum ending at cut <= the median of the same 7-day sums over cut-179..cut (net outflow regime)
trials.OC3_ETH_EXSUPPLY_TIMING: ON when ln(SplyExNtv[cut] / SplyExNtv[cut-28]) < 0 (supply on exchanges falling)
trials.OC4_ETH_ACTIVITY_TIMING: ON when ln(mean AdrActCnt cut-27..cut / mean AdrActCnt cut-55..cut-28) > 0 (network activity rising)

decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0102 (alpha t vs EW U50 market matters most for a timing rule); DSR N=4 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 reported
known_limits_written_before_results: Timing rules are one directional bet at a time: about 58 decisions in S1 and effectively one independent name; MDE about 2.1. Coin Metrics history may be revised.
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +4 regardless.
